outcome.analysis_limit: The 89 omitted operation records are the projection's bounded response omission count; they do not measure operations rejected by the capture limit. The projection establishes that the 128-record capture limit was reached in this session, but not how many later operations were unrecorded. The repository branch and head are the session snapshot, not a live Git probe. One session does not establish cross-session recurrence.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Long-running sessions can reach the authenticated read-activity capture bound before their work ends
pressure_hypothesis.basis: One authenticated Environment projection reports 128 captured Control read operations, a 128-operation per-session limit, and limit_reached=true. The selected event window continues through sequence 265 while the newest captured RPC operation is ordinal 128 at sequence 193. This establishes saturation in one real session; it does not establish how many later operations were suppressed.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Keep session activity capture bounded, but align its capacity with the existing bounded event-tail reconciliation window and report when a session resumes after an older limit.
